title: Streamed usage in a final chunk with no choices
summary: The model finishes a short streamed answer, then reports usage in a chunk with no choices.

messages.content: In one short sentence, explain why the sky looks blue.

requirements.text: Token usage is reported and matches the provider's counts.

grading_notes: Usage comes only in a final chunk with choices: []. A library that crashes on empty choices grades CRASH. A library that needs an opt-in to receive streamed usage is fine when the shim passes it the library's own way.
